title: Structural Functional Analysis
description: Fundamental principles of functional analysis: duality, Hahn-Banach, open mapping, weak topologies, and fixed points (B01-B16)

declarations.name: Bounded Linear Operators and Operator Norm
declarations.scope_summary: Normed spaces X, Y; L(X,Y) with operator norm
declarations.statement_summary: A linear operator T: X -> Y is continuous iff it is bounded; L(X,Y) is complete when Y is complete.

declarations.name: Continuous Dual Space and Bidual Evaluation
declarations.scope_summary: Dual X* = L(X, K) and canonical evaluation embedding j: X -> X**
declarations.statement_summary: X* is always a Banach space; j(x)(f) = f(x) gives an isometric linear embedding of X into X**.

declarations.name: Hahn-Banach Extension Theorem
declarations.statement_summary: Every bounded linear functional on a subspace extends to the whole space with preserved operator norm.

declarations.name: Geometric Hahn-Banach Hyperplane Separation
declarations.scope_summary: Convex sets in locally convex / normed spaces
declarations.statement_summary: Disjoint nonempty convex sets, one open, are separated by a continuous closed hyperplane.

declarations.name: Uniform Boundedness Principle (Banach-Steinhaus)
declarations.scope_summary: Banach domain X, normed codomain Y
declarations.statement_summary: A family of bounded linear operators pointwise bounded on a Banach space is uniformly bounded in operator norm.

declarations.name: Open Mapping and Closed Graph Theorems
declarations.statement_summary: A surjective bounded linear operator is open; a closed linear operator defined on the whole space is bounded.

declarations.name: Weak and Weak* Topologies in Banach Spaces
declarations.scope_summary: Weak topology sigma(X, X*) and weak* topology sigma(X*, X)
declarations.statement_summary: Coarsest topologies making elements of X* (resp. X) continuous; norm is lower semicontinuous.

declarations.name: Banach-Alaoglu Weak* Compactness Theorem
declarations.scope_summary: Dual space X* under weak* topology
declarations.statement_summary: The closed unit ball in the continuous dual space X* is compact in the weak* topology.

declarations.name: Reflexivity and Weak Compactness of Unit Ball
declarations.statement_summary: A Banach space is reflexive (X = X**) iff its closed unit ball is weakly compact; L^p is reflexive for 1 < p < infty.

declarations.name: Hilbert Projection Theorem and Riesz Representation
declarations.statement_summary: Every closed subspace admits an orthogonal direct sum decomposition H = M oplus M^perp; H* is isometrically antilinear isomorphic to H.

declarations.name: Orthonormal Systems and Parseval Identity
declarations.scope_summary: Hilbert space H with complete orthonormal system
declarations.statement_summary: Bessel inequality and Parseval identity ||x||^2 = sum_i |<x, e_i>|^2 for complete orthonormal systems.

declarations.name: Riesz-Markov-Kakutani Measure Representation
declarations.scope_summary: Continuous functionals on C(K) for compact Hausdorff K
declarations.statement_summary: Every positive linear functional on C(K) is represented by integration against a unique regular Borel measure.

declarations.name: Mazur Lemma on Convex Weak Closure
declarations.statement_summary: A convex subset of a normed space is closed in the norm topology if and only if it is weakly closed.

declarations.name: Schauder Bases and Locally Convex Fréchet Spaces
declarations.statement_summary: Schauder basis representation x = sum_n c_n e_n with unique continuous coordinate functionals.

declarations.name: Banach Contraction Principle and Geometric Convergence
declarations.statement_summary: Contraction mapping T with constant q < 1 has a unique fixed point with error ||x_n - x*|| <= q^n / (1-q) ||x_1 - x_0||.

declarations.name: Schauder Compact Fixed Point Theorem
declarations.scope_summary: Compact convex subsets in Banach spaces
declarations.statement_summary: Every continuous map of a nonempty compact convex subset of a Banach space into itself has at least one fixed point.
